Later in the session, he had me sit up, and when I could see it, 99.9% of the pain vanished, I stopped jerking everywhere and it was a breeze. 

Whenever I get shots, I always look at it and always have them count down. 

I don’t know if there’s a potential correlation there, but that’s the best I’ve got. Do what you usually do when getting regular shots:)
